description: Example project-local config for SC-Agent CLI
_trust_note: #469 — a repo-shipped .sc-agent.json can only RESTRICT, never elevate. Ignored at project scope (stderr warning per key): model.baseUrl, model.apiKey, profiles.*.baseUrl/apiKey, mcp.servers, plugins, settings.formatters, permissions.autoApprove. Set those in ~/.sc-agent/config.json or via SC_BASE_URL/SC_API_KEY.

model._comment: baseUrl/apiKey deliberately omitted — privileged keys ignored at project scope. Global config or env vars (SC_BASE_URL/SC_API_KEY) own endpoint + credentials.

permissions._autoApprove_note: autoApprove omitted — ignored at project scope (#469); it can only widen approvals from the global config.
permissions._denyPaths_note: Project denyPaths merge ADDITIVELY over the global list — entries are added, global entries cannot be removed.
permissions._denyCommands_note: Project denyCommands merge additively too (#469) — the shipped #471 credential-read defaults (`cat .env`, `cat *.key|*.pem`, `cat ~/.ssh/*`, `.sc-agent/config.json`, `/proc/*/environ`) can never be removed from project scope. To REPLACE them, set denyCommands in the global config and copy the defaults from docs/permission-profiles.md.

run_shell._comment: #471 — spawned commands get a scrubbed env (PATH/HOME/shell basics only; credentials stripped unconditionally). allowedEnvVars passes extra VAR NAMES through; credential-shaped names are always ignored.

sandbox._comment: Opt-in tool-call sandboxing (#423). See docs/sandboxing.md. enabled defaults to false; empty egressAllowlist blocks all non-loopback egress; denyPaths/denyCommands still apply (deny wins). #469: once trusted config enables the sandbox, project-scope sandbox.* keys are dropped — a repo can opt in/tighten, never weaken.

context._comment: Context injection mode (#461): 'full' (default) injects AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md verbatim; 'skeleton' injects a generated repo map instead — the agent pulls file bodies via read_file. SC_CONTEXT_MODE env overrides this.

webFetch._comment: web_fetch egress policy (#470): http(s)-only, private/loopback/link-local/reserved destinations blocked on every redirect hop. allowlist (same syntax as sandbox.egressAllowlist) restricts fetchable host[:port] — empty means public internet only. allowPrivateHosts is the explicit escape hatch for local dev. maxBytes caps streamed bodies (default 5242880).
